original_upstream_suite.scope: Original pHash.c and test_phash.c compiled unchanged, Apple ARM64.

method: Harness includes original pHash.c, preinitializes all64 output coefficients to sentinel and invokes original static NEON transform on zero input. No uninitialized-memory read needed in control.
limits: No ASAN, original aetilius/pHash or deferred native backend execution.
